models_evaluated: deep learning patient-trial matching framework with patient-criterion level fairness constraint

links.outcome: Reduction of biased predictions in patient-trial matching with fairness constraint
links.effect: Reported qualitatively: the proposed fairness framework alleviated predictions tending to be biased on real-world patient-trial and patient-criterion matching tasks; no numbers given in the abstract.
links.quote: The experimental results on real-world patient-trial and patient-criterion matching tasks demonstrate that the proposed framework can successfully alleviate the predictions that tend to be biased.

screen.reason: Evaluates a new model training/loss constraint method (patient-criterion level fairness constraint) on benchmark patient-trial matching datasets to address algorithmic bias, rather than evaluating an organizational deployment guardrail.
